The fair-value NAV exceeds the par-value NAV by 45.50p, representing a 5.10% premium, reflecting valuation adjustments to debt. These NAV figures are unaudited and provided for investor information as at the stated date. The company states debt fair value is an estimate based on a discount rate derived from UK gilt redemption yields plus a credit spread using ICE BofAML 5–10 Year indices, updated monthly and applied daily, which may affect reported NAV volatility. Inclusion of current-year revenue raised NAV by 12.60p (approximately +1.18%), and valuing debt at fair value increased NAV by about 5.15p (approximately +0.48%); NAVs were calculated in accordance with AIC recommendations.
